name: MF Invoice MCP
description: An MCP server that integrates with MoneyForward Cloud Invoice API v3 to automate the creation and management of quotes and invoices. It supports Japanese invoice system compliance, allowing users to handle partners, items, and billing through natural language.

MF_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID obtained from the MoneyForward Cloud developer settings.

MF_CALLBACK_PORT.description: Port for the OAuth redirect URI (e.g., http://localhost:38080/callback). Default is 38080.

MF_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client Secret obtained from the MoneyForward Cloud developer settings.
